context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 verified 2 new features: (1) Edit Piutang Kios Mitra - PUT /api/partner-stores/{store_id}/edit-debt with {type:'payment'/'correction', amount:X, notes:''}. Payment mode reduces debt by amount. Correction mode sets debt to exact value. Creates audit_log with action='EDIT_PIUTANG_MITRA'. Frontend has CreditCard icon button (data-testid='debt-store-{id}') that opens dialog (data-testid='edit-debt-dialog'). Dialog shows current debt, type select, amount input with real-time remaining calculation, notes input, and submit button. (2) Dashboard Stock Out with Cost Price - GET /api/dashboard/stats returns stock_out_today, stock_out_today_pos, stock_out_today_partner. Calculation uses product's cost_price/items_per_box (not item-level price). POS always uses per-unit cost. Partner orders check warehouse_unit: dus uses full cost_price, satuan uses cost_price/items_per_box. Dashboard card shows 'POS: Rp X | Mitra: Rp Y' breakdown.

feature_1_edit_piutang.payment_mode: amount > 0, new_debt = max(0, old_debt - amount), creates payment_history

feature_2_stock_out_cost_price.partner_calculation: For each item: if warehouse_unit == 'dus' then qty * cost_price, else qty * (cost_price / items_per_box)
